name: Code editor
what: VS Code's editor: syntax colours, multi-cursor, find and replace, minimap, folding.

name: PHP IntelliSense
what: Completion, hover, go to definition and diagnostics for PHP - running inside your site, on your own code.

name: Laravel names
what: Completes route(), view(), config() and <x-component> names from your app, and ⌘-click from a view name to its Blade file.

name: Emmet
what: Abbreviations that expand to HTML and CSS: div.card>h2+p then Tab.

name: Prettier
what: Format Document (⇧⌥F) for PHP and Markdown.

name: Tailwind CSS classes
by: codeinchrome, from the Tailwind CSS docs
what: Class name completion inside class="..." on sites that use Tailwind, with variants (md:hover:...).

name: Markdown preview
what: A Preview button on .md files, rendered safely: no script in a README can run.

name: Material Icon Theme
what: File and folder icons by name and type, the same set as the VS Code extension.

name: PDF and image preview
what: Opens PDFs page by page and images at their size, instead of as unreadable text.

name: Laravel Boost MCP
what: Your site's own Laravel docs, schema and routes for AI agents, read-only (cic.mcp).
